name: PaletteBlackfen
intent: A peat bog of standing stones: true near-black brown peat underfoot, a pale flagstone causeway and grey moonlit stones standing out of it, still black pools and one cold will-o'-wisp blue accent under a drowned-parish night.
requests: A water-surface colour role for pools, so still black bog water reads from the high camera; the palette sets only the pool bed.

critic_pass1.why: The will-o'-wisp blue is a good accent, but the 'near-black peat' renders as mid olive almost identical to B, so it never reads as bog.
critic_pass1.fix: walk ground 15 values darker and browner (true peat) so the pale causeway and grey stones stand out of it

critic_pass2.why: The biggest gain of the rework: the ground went from olive grass that read as the field to true near-black peat, so the pale causeway and grey stones stand out and the cold wisp-blue reads as the one colour.
